newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Jan 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Jan 3.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following major business stories on Friday:

WASHINGTON - Negotiations in the 19-day Teamster strike against Giant Foods Inc. were scheduled to resume after the company indicated it would be willing to accept restrictions on its ability to contract work to outsiders.
WASHINGTON - AT&T and Telco Communications group Inc. are trading lawsuits over advertisements for long-distance telephone savings.
WASHINGTON - The stock market's first trading day of the New Year wasn't for the faint of heart with the Dow Jones industrial average falling 95 points.
WASHINGTON - The tiny Fairfax, Va. firm of TransactNet has designed software to make getting information from the Internet virtually effortless.
